title: Path with Maximum Probability

tests.name: Random small
tests.data:
import random
random.seed(1514)
cases = []
for _ in range(40):
    n = random.randint(2, 7)
    pairs = sorted({tuple(random.sample(range(n), 2)) for _ in range(random.randint(0, 10))})
    cases.append((n, [list(p) for p in pairs], [round(random.random(), 2) for _ in pairs], 0, n - 1))
